source.geometry_and_depth_semantics: same frozen MB-System source implementation as prior all66 gates

spatial_gate.per_lineage_per_cell: median of all non-null raw EM12 beams whose reconstructed Earth position lies in the cell

predeclared_interpretation.LINE32_SYSTEMATIC_DEEP_BIAS_SUPPORTED: line32 is deeper than line18 in >=0.80 of common cells and median line32-line18 difference >=100m, while line18 has smaller median absolute residual to both independent 2008 lineages
predeclared_interpretation.LINE18_SYSTEMATIC_SHALLOW_BIAS_SUPPORTED: inverse directional condition with line18 shallower by >=100m and line32 closer to both 2008 lineages
predeclared_interpretation.RAW_LINEAGE_SYSTEMATIC_DISCORDANCE_SUPPO: absolute median line32-line18 difference >=100m but neither acquisition is closer to both 2008 lineages
predeclared_interpretation.LOCAL_CELL_ONLY: absolute median line32-line18 difference <50m across common cells
predeclared_interpretation.MIXED_OR_INSUFFICIENT: otherwise or support below prereg minimum
